facts.desc: Analyses: reasoning written up about the product or the work, kept where the project KB can reason over it.
facts.name: analyses_only

facts.desc: Questions and requests that wait on a person (usually you).
facts.name: asks

facts.desc: Bugs and feature requests; the tracker owns them, the hub keeps copies of the relevant ones.
facts.name: backlog

facts.desc: What stops this ticket from being done: open questions, failing or missing checks, open proofs or demos, conflicts.
facts.name: blocking

facts.desc: What every session loads at start: the hub's rules and pointers.
facts.name: boot

facts.desc: Context written down so that a later session can pick up an item without the original conversation.
facts.name: capsules

facts.desc: The tests of each claim, and the record of each run with its result.
facts.name: checks

facts.desc: What must become true, stay true, or stop being true for this ticket, each with a concrete example.
facts.name: claims

facts.desc: Decisions about the product or domain that outlive one ticket, with who decided and when.
facts.name: decisions

facts.desc: Design documents that matter to current work, pinned from where they live.
facts.name: designs

facts.desc: Where the human, the agent, or a result disagreed, and what the agent disclosed about its guesses and errors.
facts.name: divergences

facts.desc: Work passed from one session to another, and whether it was accepted.
facts.name: handoffs

facts.desc: Rules of thumb learned in this hub, for agents to apply.
facts.name: heuristics

facts.desc: What discovery believes the problem is, its premises, and the result that would show it false.
facts.name: hypothesis

facts.desc: Formal models (Lean, SMT, TLA+) and the proofs that a claim rests on.
facts.name: models

facts.desc: Drafts of text meant for the tracker or for people, staged before anyone sends them.
facts.name: outbound

facts.desc: The product's business rules: how the current system must behave (limits, permissions, prices, workflows).
facts.name: product_rules

facts.desc: Raw reports and meeting transcripts: the human touchpoints of the week. The project KB keeps a pinned digest; an agent reads a transcript and records what is needed in the ledger, with a transcript ref.
facts.name: raw_reports

facts.desc: Which repositories exist, what each holds, and how they connect.
facts.name: repos

facts.desc: The ticket's request, word for word, and the human's answers to its questions.
facts.name: request

facts.desc: Who owns each item, who it waits on, the threads around it, and what is on hold.
facts.name: routing

facts.desc: The named sessions of the hub, their roles, and what each hands to whom.
facts.name: sessions

facts.desc: How the team works: the process and its steps. Kept outside the hub; the build does not need it.
facts.name: sop

facts.desc: The technologies of the project, and how to use them here.
facts.name: tech

facts.desc: The ticket's text and state as the tracker holds it.
facts.name: ticket_body

facts.desc: A short summary of a ticket's history, written when its details are too old to keep.
facts.name: ticket_capsules

facts.desc: What happened to a ticket and when: opened, moved, blocked, closed.
facts.name: ticket_events

facts.desc: At each weekly rotation, the decision recorded for each item that came due: keep, lapse, capsule, escalate.
facts.name: triage

facts.desc: Facts about how the current system behaves now, each with where it was observed.
facts.name: world

stores.name: spec
stores.owns: Everything one ticket must achieve and (when completed) the evidence that the ticket has been satisfied.

stores.name: project
stores.owns: Two sides: Decisions about future work and definitions about the current system. Where the product is and where it is going.

stores.name: ledger
stores.owns: What needs to be done, who is doing the work, whats blocking what, right now. Nothing about project rules or decisions.

stores.name: memory
stores.owns: What every agent must know at start: boot context, heuristics, technologies, and the list of bespoke tools that other tasks can reuse.

stores.name: weeks
stores.owns: The raw material of each week: session transcripts and the reports written that week. Transcripts are indexed into the ledger; analyses that last go to the project KB.

stores.name: bespoke
stores.owns: Helper scripts, skills and small stores an agent makes for this project where nothing else fits: listed where agents look, and pruned like everything else if they stop being used.

stores.name: tracker
stores.owns: The client's system of record. It owns the tickets (request, answers, events), checks and runs, world facts (the code and git), and all designs, bugs and features. A copy that the hub shows there belongs to the store it comes from.
